definitions.explanation: Having a quality of beauty, grace, and sophistication in manner, appearance, or lifestyle.

examples.japanese: バレリーナが{優雅|ゆうが}に{踊|おど}っている。
{休日|きゅうじつ}に{優雅|ゆうが}なアフタヌーンティーを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed an elegant afternoon tea on my day off.

notes:
{優雅|ゆうが} is a na-adjective describing refined beauty, grace, and an unhurried air of sophistication.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {優雅|ゆうが}な (e.g., {優雅|ゆうが}な{暮|く}らし)
- Adverbial: {優雅|ゆうが}に (e.g., {優雅|ゆうが}に{踊|おど}る)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優雅|ゆうが}な{生活|せいかつ}: elegant lifestyle
- {優雅|ゆうが}に{過|す}ごす: to spend time in a refined manner
- {優雅|ゆうが}な{動|うご}き: graceful movement
- {優雅|ゆうが}な{雰囲気|ふんいき}: elegant atmosphere
- {優雅|ゆうが}な{午後|ごご}: a leisurely afternoon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上品|じょうひん}: refined, tasteful (focuses on manners/taste)
- エレガント: elegant (loanword, often for fashion)
- {優雅|ゆうが} emphasizes a sense of leisurely grace and luxury, not just good taste
